title: v3 conformance adapter Input
description: The stdin JSON an adapter reads: a v3 document, the verifier nonce, the pinned repo, and the synthetic trust anchors it was produced under. Empty/absent anchor fields select the embedded production roots.

verification_time_unix.description: pins the quote-layer clock (seconds since the epoch) for CRL and certificate validity windows, so a frozen real document replays at its capture time; absent/0 verifies at the current time. Sigstore verification uses the bundle's own observer timestamps and is unaffected.
